messages.author: ff7d32384083b3d7
messages.subject: Error in coverageObj <- getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 20)
parts:
Hello Yuchao,

I encountered the following error message when calling function getcoverage(), I was able to run through CODEX for another set of samples without any problems. Not sure why it gave me error message for this set of sample, the only difference I can think of is there is "@" in the sample names for this set, for example, "NA07034@1099927558", "201040989@0175535881", will that be a problem?

Any suggestions, thanks!


> coverageObj <- getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 20)
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘scanBam’ for signature ‘"data.frame"’

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] Error in coverageObj <- getcoverage(bambedObj, mapqthres = 20)
parts:
Hi Peng,

I’m not sure. This part of the code has been used very extensively and there should not be any bugs. Also scanBam() is part of Rsamtools, which CODEX is dependent on. Based only on the error you sent me, I cannot tell exactly what’s going on but you can: (1) run getcoverage() function line by line and see what’s wrong with your input or bam; (2) send me your image file using save.image(file=‘codex_debug.rda’) and I can check if there’s anything that you miss.

Yuchao
